skills.trigger: When evaluating a large pleural-based mass on CT to distinguish pleuropulmonary synovial sarcoma from other malignancies like primary lung cancer or metastases.
steps: Inspect the internal architecture of the mass on CT, specifically looking for coarse, peripheral calcifications.

Differentiate from primary lung cancers and metastases, which typically present as soft-tissue density masses without prominent intratumoral calcification; the presence of such calcification strongly favors synovial sarcoma.
